# Every fact in the text comes from the Evidence Core

## Rule
Every figure, name, date and link in the text is in the Evidence Core, and is
quoted as the core has it.

## Criterion
For each factual item in the text: is there a core entry that states it, and does
the text state it as that entry does? A "yes" needs the entry; an item with no
entry fails, and an item stated differently from its entry fails.

## Enforces
I-03. The core is the only source of fact; nothing enters the text past it.

## Route
| Finding | Route | Cause | Counter | On exhaustion |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| a fact is misquoted from the core | S-13 → S-12 | phrasing_or_removable_fact | L_edit | skip_publication |
| a fact is not in the core, branch **removable** | S-13 → S-12 | phrasing_or_removable_fact | L_edit | skip_publication |
| a fact is not in the core, branch **load-bearing** | S-13 → S-08 | structural_or_load_bearing_fault | L_strategy | skip_destination |

## Branch criterion
Code locates the unsupported item and the plan elements — thesis, promise, move,
opening — that reference the text span. The truth call answers one question: can
each of those elements still be executed with only core material? Yes →
`removable`, and the Writer edits against the same plan. No → `load-bearing`, and
the plan required material the core does not hold. When uncertain, the plan
branch: a decision error is never charged to the Writer.
